translations.web: Yes, Yahweh will give that which is good. Our land will yield its increase.
translations.bsb: The LORD will indeed provide what is good, and our land will yield its increase.
translations.kjv: Yea, the LORD shall give that which is good; and our land shall yield her increase.
translations.asv: Yea, Jehovah will give that which is good; And our land shall yield its increase.
